statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-127039 (GNUTLS-SA-2026-11-18-1): in libgnutls, _gnutls_pcert_to_auth_info (lib/auth/cert.c) freed the stored certificate list but left the list pointer and count set when the new allocation failed, so a later session cleanup could dereference a NULL pointer or free the list twice. The fix clears both fields before allocating. Upstream says it was introduced in GnuTLS 2.5.9 and fixed it in GnuTLS 3.8.14, released 2026-11-18, with commit 0cf60141ca2c1289e96847261ff355010cb6f3a8: https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/commit/0cf60141ca2c1289e96847261ff355010cb6f3a8, https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/blob/3.8.14/NEWS . Alpine's 3.23-stable gnutls APKBUILD builds 3.8.14-r0 from the 3.8.14 release and lists CVE-2026-127039 under its 3.8.14-r0 security fixes: https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/blob/3.23-stable/main/gnutls/APKBUILD . We downloaded every package built from the gnutls source in the Alpine 3.23 index of the DHI Alpine repository: gnutls, gnutls-c++, gnutls-dbg, gnutls-dev, gnutls-doc and gnutls-utils, each at 3.8.11-r0, 3.8.12-r0, 3.8.13-r0 and 3.8.14-r0 for x86_64 and aarch64, 48 apks, and checked each download against its index checksum; no gnutls package is published in the DHI Alpine security repository. The library code is in libgnutls.so.30 in the gnutls package; gnutls-c++ ships the C++ wrapper libgnutlsxx.so.30, the seven gnutls-utils programs list libgnutls.so.30 as a needed library, gnutls-dev ships headers, pkg-config data and the libgnutls.so and libgnutlsxx.so symbolic links and no static library, and gnutls-dbg ships debug symbols. The GnuTLS version string in libgnutls.so.30 reads 3.8.11, 3.8.12, 3.8.13 and 3.8.14 in the matching builds on both architectures. So 3.8.11-r0, 3.8.12-r0 and 3.8.13-r0 are affected and 3.8.14-r0 is the first fixed build.
